name: EMCOR Group, Inc.
base_source: TTM through Q2 2026 from EDGAR 10-Q YTD (OCF $1,289.8M - capex $118.4M - SBC ~$0 = $1,171.4M / 44.62M diluted shares); corroborates normalized median $26.34
moat_justification: US scale/breadth across electrical + mechanical trades, hyperscaler qualification and execution record (10% op margin vs ~7% peer median), skilled-labor pipeline and debt-free balance sheet — but work is re-won bid-by-bid, backlog burns in ~12 months, labor walks, and data-center concentration (34% of revenue) is rising; narrow moat, CAP 8.5y.
one_liner: Best-in-class specialty contractor, moat 5/10, no debt — but at $776 (~30x TTM owner's earnings) even the super-bull case only returns ~15%; clears the 15% hurdle only at ~$412 (~$330 with a margin of safety).
